name: olivia-mode
description: Interview the user relentlessly about a plan or design through a branching decision tree served in a local web app, until reaching shared understanding. Ships a Planning Facilitator output style and a PreToolUse gate that blocks deliverable writes no completed interview authorizes.

gated_projects.title: Gated projects
gated_projects.description: Absolute paths of projects where creating a markdown document requires a completed Olivia interview that declares it as a deliverable. Leave empty to disable the write gate everywhere.
